source_hypotheses.required: Continuous trace functions on G_Q with values in a common finite extension of Q_ell with its ell-adic topology, invariant under conjugacy, agreeing on arithmetic Frobenius outside a finite set.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The two trace functions on a common finite coefficient field; a finite comparison exception set.
source_hypotheses.justification: Chebotarev density, conjugacy invariance and continuity extend the equality. The required assertion is the trace equality, not an isomorphism.

constructed_objects.required: A common finite extension of Q_ell, with its ell-adic topology, in which both continuous trace functions take values.
constructed_objects.constructed: Extend the two chosen coefficient embeddings compatibly to one finite extension of Q_ell.
constructed_objects.justification: This is the same coefficient extension used by the retained compatibility proof; no coefficient embedding is replaced.

index_domain_coverage.required: All G_Q elements, rather than a set of selected Frobenius representatives alone.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Conjugacy saturation of the cofinite Frobenius set is dense.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Continuous equalities on this dense set extend to every group element.

transition_maps.required: Transport traces through the fixed embeddings and conjugations.
transition_maps.constructed: Traces are conjugacy invariant and embeddings are injective.
transition_maps.justification: Conjugating a Frobenius representative does not change either trace.

consumed_object_identity.required: The actual two trace functions appearing in the comparison.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: The original r_ell and corresponding realization of the same f are retained by the caller.
consumed_object_identity.justification: The source lemma does not construct a replacement form or representation.

coefficient_conventions.required: Characteristic zero and compatible Frobenius conventions.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Arithmetic Frobenius is used for both functions after the explicitly stated Tate/cohomological duality.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The cohomological geometric-Frobenius normalization is converted before applying this lemma.

local_conditions.required: A finite exception set suffices for density.
local_conditions.constructed: Exclude comparison denominators, ramification, bad reduction, ell and the form level.
local_conditions.justification: This set is a comparison set only; it does not enlarge the controlled ramification support T.

exceptional_cases.required: No demand that the form level or comparison set has already been bounded.
exceptional_cases.justification: The subsequent conductor bound is not a premise of this density argument.

downstream_consumption.required: Trace equality needed by the characteristic-zero semisimple criterion.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Equality on every element of G_Q.
downstream_consumption.justification: No local conductor or original nonsemisimple representation conclusion is supplied here.

source_hypotheses.required: Two finite-dimensional semisimple representations over characteristic zero with equal traces on every group element.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Semisimplifications over the common finite coefficient extension.
source_hypotheses.justification: Use the standalone semisimple character lemma identified in C5 of the retained character connection, not a rational compatible-system theorem.

constructed_objects.required: Finite-dimensional modules for the same group.
constructed_objects.constructed: The original r_ell and the semisimplification of U_f,ell.
constructed_objects.justification: Semisimplification preserves traces; the caller separately supplies semisimplicity of r_ell.

index_domain_coverage.constructed: The output of the density and continuity argument.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Equality on a few Frobenius elements is not substituted for this input.

transition_maps.required: Identification as representations over a common characteristic-zero coefficient extension.
transition_maps.constructed: An isomorphism r_ell isomorphic to U_f,ell semisimplified.
transition_maps.justification: The source criterion concerns semisimple representations; it does not assert that U_f,ell was already semisimple.

consumed_object_identity.required: Keep the original factor and corresponding chosen coefficient embedding of f.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Exactly the modules whose traces were compared.
consumed_object_identity.justification: No different irreducible constituent is selected.

coefficient_conventions.required: Finite coefficient extensions and characteristic zero.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The common coefficient extension of the two original embeddings.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The criterion is not applied to residual representations.

local_conditions.required: No local deformation, ordinarity or conductor premise.
local_conditions.constructed: A global representation isomorphism after semisimplification only.
local_conditions.justification: Local statements are obtained later from the actual representation isomorphism.

exceptional_cases.required: A possible nontrivial extension in U_f,ell must not be discarded silently.
exceptional_cases.constructed: It remains outside this source lemma.
exceptional_cases.justification: The separately retained length-one argument uses absolute irreducibility to recover U_f,ell itself.

downstream_consumption.required: The semisimplified comparison needed by the compatibility proof.
downstream_consumption.justification: Actual U_f,ell and local conductor equality remain later, separate deductions.

source_hypotheses.required: A number field L-prime and an abelian surface A over it with every geometric rational endomorphism defined there and End^0(A_Qbar)=B; a continuous normalized G_Q-action over the original finite splitting extension E_lambda/Q_ell, commuting with B and restricting on G_L-prime to the scalar-extended Tate action of A.
source_hypotheses.constructed: For each ell the same A, L-prime, original matrix units and splitting field.
source_hypotheses.justification: These hypotheses are explicitly retained in the source proof. Normalizer isogenies alone do not imply them.

constructed_objects.required: The original rank-two factor after splitting B.
constructed_objects.constructed: The image of its original primitive idempotent e_11 in V_ell(A) tensor E_lambda.
constructed_objects.justification: A change of matrix units is inner and commutes with the group action, hence identifies that original factor equivariantly.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every rational coefficient prime, including 2, and every finite coefficient extension.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Faltings semisimplicity and endomorphism comparison at each ell.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The proof is uniform in ell but uses no ordinarity or residual hypothesis.

transition_maps.required: Commutants must commute with scalar extension.
transition_maps.constructed: A finite system of linear equations cuts out the commutant.
transition_maps.justification: Its kernel commutes with field extension; separability in characteristic zero preserves semisimplicity.

consumed_object_identity.required: The original factor on G_L-prime and then on G_Q.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: End of the factor is the coefficient field after every finite extension.
consumed_object_identity.justification: A proper invariant summand would give a nontrivial idempotent in this field; a G_Q-invariant subspace is also G_L-prime invariant.

coefficient_conventions.required: Original coefficient embedding and finite splitting extension.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: All calculations are over that field and its finite extensions.
coefficient_conventions.justification: A subspace over the algebraic closure descends to a finite extension, proving absolute irreducibility.

local_conditions.constructed: The caller supplies that restriction as the ordinary Tate action.
local_conditions.justification: No new field is introduced to repair a failure of the restriction hypothesis.

exceptional_cases.required: Exclude the CM case and a merely quadratic subfield endomorphism calculation.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Full B, rather than E alone, is the geometric endomorphism algebra.
exceptional_cases.justification: The lemma does not claim the same conclusion from compatible normalizers or E-linearity.

downstream_consumption.required: Absolute irreducibility of the original factor needed by the length-one comparison.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The actual r_ell is absolutely irreducible for every ell.
downstream_consumption.justification: No conductor, ramification-support, field-degree or modularity bound is produced by this lemma.

source_hypotheses.required: The D210 non-CM surface A, full End^0=B, common Hom field L, and finite choices of actual B-linear isogenies mu_sigma: sigma A to A.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The actual maps provided by the preceding full-B construction, with mu_1=1.
source_hypotheses.justification: The source section4 uses these separately established inputs; its scalar calculation does not manufacture them.

constructed_objects.required: Invertible rational endomorphisms from the composition discrepancies.
constructed_objects.justification: All three maps are the chosen maps of the same finite family and are defined over the common field.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every pair sigma,tau after inflation from Gal(L/Q).
index_domain_coverage.constructed: A finite normalized choice for each element, then its inflation.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The identity choice ensures the normalized cocycle identities; no coherent descent datum is assumed.

transition_maps.required: Composition must commute with the full quaternion action.
transition_maps.constructed: c(sigma,tau) commutes with B and lies in End^0(A)=B.
transition_maps.justification: It therefore lies in the center Q^*, not merely in a chosen quadratic subfield.

consumed_object_identity.required: The same maps used by the scalar-family caller.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: No Skolem-Noether replacement of this controlled family.
consumed_object_identity.justification: Functorial Tate realization applies to the same algebraic composition identities.

coefficient_conventions.required: Rational quasi-isogenies and every coefficient prime.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The scalar discrepancies are rational and their Tate actions agree for every ell.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Rationalization is explicit; integral lattice preservation is not asserted.

local_conditions.required: The original common field and finite inflated choices.
local_conditions.constructed: All maps remain over L; no new conductor claim is made.
local_conditions.justification: The scalar calculation is independent of a later ramification-removal cochain.

exceptional_cases.required: Do not identify scalar discrepancies with signs before degree normalization.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Only membership in Q^* and the two-cocycle identity are concluded.
exceptional_cases.justification: Positive algebraic degree normalization and sign-cochain splitting are separate downstream steps.

downstream_consumption.required: Rational scalar cocycle for degree normalization and Tate realization.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The fixed algebraic scalar identity for the actual b-family.
downstream_consumption.justification: This supplies neither Frobenius compatibility nor modularity nor a bounded descent field by itself.

source_hypotheses.required: A normalized primitive weight-two newform f of level N and its characteristic-zero ell-adic realization.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The realization for any chosen embedding of the coefficient field.
source_hypotheses.justification: Carayol1987 sections2.1,2.4,4.1 and the following consequence give the direct conductor statement; the source review checks these locators.

constructed_objects.required: The actual modular Galois representation, allowing general coefficient field and nebentypus.
constructed_objects.constructed: U_f,ell in the Tate convention, or the explicitly dual cohomological convention.
constructed_objects.justification: Neither rational coefficients nor trivial nebentypus is required.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every finite prime p distinct from ell, including p=2 and p dividing N.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The full local Artin/Weil-Deligne conductor exponent.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The conclusion is not restricted to good primes or tame inertia.

transition_maps.required: Match source and consumer normalization before comparing conductors.
transition_maps.constructed: Duality and unramified normalization changes preserve the local conductor.
transition_maps.justification: These operations do not assert identical Frobenius matrices in different conventions.

consumed_object_identity.required: The final primitive form f, after any finite twist was absorbed.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Its level N and the representation of that same form.
consumed_object_identity.justification: An earlier form or the controlled sign character is not substituted for the final primitive form.

coefficient_conventions.required: Characteristic-zero coefficient embedding and full Artin conductor.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The Swan contribution is included; coefficient extension does not change the exponent.

local_conditions.required: p differs from the coefficient residue characteristic ell.
local_conditions.constructed: For each p choose an auxiliary ell not equal to p.
local_conditions.justification: The theorem is not applied at p=ell.

exceptional_cases.required: Wild and dyadic primes must remain covered.
exceptional_cases.constructed: They are included by the all-finite-prime statement with ell different from p.
exceptional_cases.justification: The elliptic-curve-only corollary is not used for arbitrary coefficient fields.

downstream_consumption.required: The primitive-level equality to combine with a separately proved actual-family local isomorphism.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Only the modular side conductor equals v_p(N).
downstream_consumption.justification: The beta/b comparison, their controlled fields and their ramification estimates remain outside this source node.
